findings.title: Missing refreshUser function in AuthContext
findings.description: Profile component calls refreshUser() from useAuth() hook but this function is not defined in AuthContext. Profile.jsx lines 12, 79, and 99 reference refreshUser.
findings.consequence: Runtime error when user attempts to upload photo or edit their name. Will throw 'refreshUser is not a function' error, blocking all profile updates.
findings.correction: Add refreshUser function to AuthContext that calls base44.auth.me() and updates local state. Export it in the context value object.

findings.title: Firebase not initialized in frontend application
findings.description: Profile component calls getStorage() without Firebase being initialized. No firebase config found in main.jsx, app.jsx, or any config file. The .env file lacks Firebase configuration keys.
findings.consequence: When user attempts to upload profile photo, getStorage() will throw: 'Firebase: No Firebase App [DEFAULT] has been created - call Firebase App.initializeApp()'. Photo upload will fail completely.
findings.correction: Create frontend/src/config/firebase.js with initializeApp() and export pre-initialized storage. Add Firebase config keys to frontend/.env (apiKey, authDomain, projectId, storageBucket, etc.). Update Profile.jsx to import the initialized storage instance instead of calling getStorage().
